title: Intelligent Multimodal Retrieval and Reasoning for Geospatial Knowledge Discovery on the I-GUIDE Platform

live_model.evidence: Sec 5.2: "The 170 canonical user-facing questions were first drafted with o1-2024-12-17 in May 2025 to test the behavior of the production pipeline."

prompt.note: No prompt for the o1 question-drafting step is shown; the fixed system prompt quoted ("You are a geospatial expert assistant...") is for the RAG baselines being compared, not for o1's role.

claim.metric: none for o1 (used only to draft candidate benchmark questions, not evaluated itself)

data.source: I-GUIDE knowledge base; 170-question benchmark derived from it plus 100 regenerated + 262 ablation rows (release status not stated in excerpt reviewed)

notes: gpt-5-mini (undated in text) is separately used as a blind LLM-judge scoring the paper's own RAG-pipeline comparison (Faithfulness/Correctness/Completeness, Table 2), with a human calibration check on n=50 (Table 8: judge-human kappa 0.25 faithfulness, 0.52 correctness, 0.69 completeness) — role A judging the paper's own system rather than being a measured subject, and the 50-item audit sample is an internal anonymized set rather than a released dataset.
